title: Mistral model listings now show vision support
summary:
Mistral vision support is reflected in model metadata, while the docs gained a working request link and supporter references got a tidy-up.

Five Scaleway-backed Mistral configurations now accept image input in their model metadata, so clients can use the models’ existing vision capabilities instead of treating them as text-only.

The API docs now link to a new GitHub issue with the request template, rather than to the template’s YAML file. Projects can start a referrer-verification request directly from the docs.

LLMPlayground.net was removed from the website supporter list and README, including an architecture diagram that showed it hosting custom FLUX models.
